changelog.title: Grep & Pipe Mastery: BLACKSITE Terminal
changelog.description: Full bomb defusal mission with 4 BLACKSITE modules (TRACE, DECODE, EXTRACT, DEFUSE) teaching grep flags, regex patterns, and pipe chains.

changelog.title: Radio System: The Watcher
changelog.description: Tunable radio with 6 frequencies including GHOST-7 hints channel. Commands: tune, scan, radio. Hidden .signal breadcrumbs in each module.
